name: firestarter
description: Execute commerce transactions from natural language. Find products matching a request, verify suppliers, get pricing, and optionally handle payment and delivery, with an approval step before money moves.

FIRESTARTER_API_KEY.description: API key for the Firestarter Commerce Execution API. Required — the server exits on startup if unset.

FIRESTARTER_API_URL.description: Base URL for the Firestarter API. Optional — defaults to https://api.firestarter.network.

tools.name: firestarter_execute
tools.description: Execute a commerce transaction. Find products matching a natural language request, verify suppliers, get pricing, and optionally handle payment and delivery. Returns product options for approval.

request.description: Natural language description of what to buy (e.g. 'specialty coffee beans under $30')

priority.description: Optimization priority: cost (cheapest), speed (fastest delivery), quality (best rated)

auto_pay.description: If true, automatically pay for the best option within budget. If false (default), present options for approval.

tools.name: firestarter_status
tools.description: Check the status of a Firestarter execution or list recent executions. Use this to check on orders, see what options were found, or get tracking updates.

execution_id.description: Specific execution ID to check (e.g. 'exec_abc123'). Omit to list recent executions.

status_filter.description: Filter executions by status: finding, awaiting_approval, approved, paid, shipping, completed, failed, cancelled

tools.name: firestarter_approve
tools.description: Approve an execution that is awaiting approval. This selects the best option and proceeds with payment.

selected_option.description: Index of the option to select (0-based). Defaults to 0 (best option).

tools.name: firestarter_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an active execution. If payment was authorized, the hold will be released.

tools.name: firestarter_message
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to an active execution. Use this to refine the search, change requirements, or ask questions about the options.

message.description: Follow-up message (e.g. 'I prefer organic options' or 'Can you find something cheaper?')
